activity_decision.evidence: In the ORIGINAL displacement plots, all three components (N, E, U) show a clear, continuous, and sustained deviation from the pre-365 behavior starting around day 400 and persisting through the analysis period (365–729). The N component trends upward, E becomes more negative, and U shows accelerated downward motion—none revert to prior behavior. These are not isolated spikes or offsets but coherent, multi-month trends exceeding ordinary seasonal/drift variability observed in the blue-shaded normal prefix.
